definitions.explanation: The level or year a student is in at school (e.g., first grade, second year).
The annual period of schooling, typically from April to March in Japan.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{学年|がくねん}です。
{学年|がくねん}が{上|あ}がった。
{息子|むすこ}は{小学校|しょうがっこう}3{年生|ねんせい}の{学年|がくねん}にいる。
examples.english: My son is in the third grade of elementary school.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{学年|がくねん}が{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: A new school year is starting.

examples.japanese: {学年|がくねん}{末|まつ}の{試験|しけん}がある。
{日本|にほん}の{学年|がくねん}は{四月|しがつ}に{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: The school year in Japan starts in April.

notes:
{学年|がくねん} refers to both the grade level and the school year itself.

School grades in Japan:
- {小学|しょうがく}1〜6{年|ねん} (Elementary 1-6)
- {中学|ちゅうがく}1〜3{年|ねん} (Junior High 1-3)
- {高校|こうこう}1〜3{年|ねん} (High School 1-3)

Common expressions:
- {学年|がくねん}が{上|あ}がる (to advance a grade)
- {同|おな}じ{学年|がくねん} (same grade level)
- {上|うえ}/{下|した}の{学年|がくねん} (upper/lower grade)
- {学年|がくねん}{末|まつ} (end of school year)

Note: The Japanese school year starts in April and ends in March.
